B1_phase_refs_PLRU.selection: OR R/W task-user bits per resident key, soft protection mask, masked native PLRU, all-protected fallback

B2_oldest_whole_task.selection: one age-minimum live nonempty task, resident-key protection, masked native PLRU

B3_minimum_missing_whole_task.selection: current missing count then remaining count then age, resident-key protection, masked native PLRU

B4_current_fraction_MeDiC_like.selection: current resident/remaining fractions by integer cross-products; fixed 1/5 future-user admission threshold; one task protection

B5_minimum_distinct_task_refs.selection: popcount(read_users OR write_users), minimum over victim keys and q-as-bypass, insertion/PLRU tie

B6_current_fraction_always_insert.selection: same current fraction/missing/remaining/age/slot task ordering as B4, same resident-key soft protection and native PLRU; every normal cacheable full result inserts
B6_current_fraction_always_insert.reason: B4 remains frozen but its fraction=0 cold admission may continually bypass; B6 is the explicit strong always-insert branch, not a performance-driven revision

RCS1_algebraic_implementation.formula: E_q={t:(U_t-R) subseteq {q}}; C(insert(v))=|E_q|-|refs(v) intersect E_q|; D(insert(v))=|(union U-R)-{q}|+1[refs(v) nonempty]; compare bypass C/D exactly
additional_logic: Detect per task whether any current missing formal key other than q remains
Filter existing distinct-task user bitmap by the current E_q task mask
Popcount filtered users and compare complete-task and missing-union scores
Expose enough synchronized resident/lookup-use inputs at the decision boundary
Derive score-tied insertion mask and use the same native masked PLRU
RCS1_algebraic_implementation.model_selection_pipeline_contract: root fixed same one-tick choice service and one-tick normal complete-result delivery for all policies; prospective last-use scoring may compute before handoff, but private receipt/retirement/cache choice commits only after stable TC handoff; this is an unmeasured model assumption, not an actual timing result

acceptance_limits: A paper decision difference is not measured completion or performance superiority.
Shared information is paid by every policy, including phase refs and task-key incidence.
B4 may continually bypass when cold current fractions stay zero; retain that program and compare its own full episode. B6 is a separate strong always-insert fraction program added before execution.
RCS1 may use the exact ready-filtered-ref algebraic implementation; do not force 17 virtual caches or a 17-tick scan.
The extra E_q detection/filtered AND/count/read-port and synchronization/timing costs remain material even without new persistent state.
Unknown E, absolute state, interface area, cycle and ownership/error costs are null, never zero or an inferred advantage.
